{{Top|leg}}
In order to solidify its place in the market, [[Calin Industries]] introduced '''medium plating type 3''', a specialty variant of their [[Droid medium plating type 1|medium plating]] system. Only heavy plating protected better, though the cost was prohibitive for most [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owners.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
